text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm working late into the night when a
sudden
knock on the door brings a
visitor into my office.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good evening! Did someone call for an

acupuncturist? I'm here to give your
trainee's
chakra points a few pokes!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's not even here right now.
Welp, I guess
that makes sense since it's
already so late.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't you choose a
treatment
option first? ☆ I'll finish up
her treatment by
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Do you not trust me?
There's
nothing to be worried about! ☆
choice_data_list: そんなの頼んでいません
choice_data_list_en: I never asked for anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to poke a harmless needle
or two
into dear <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If the treatment is successful, the two of
you will
be able to achieve any dreams
you have! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Not a clue! After all, I've never failed
before!
choice_data_list: 失敗したらどうなるんですか？

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, that's mostly because this
will be my first
time treating anyone.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'll do the best I can! You can
trust me
on that, at the very least! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So tell me, what aspect do you want to
improve in
your trainee? I'll grant any
wish you may have
with a little poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I smell danger in the air, but I figure there might—and I emphasize might—be a chance of getting something special out of this treatment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So you want me to activate
the
strength chakra?
choice_data_list: 強いウマ娘にしてほしい
レースで勝てるようにしてほしい
元気で健康になってほしい
魅力をアップしてほしい
不安なのでやめておく
choice_data_list_en: Please make me a strong Umamusume.
Please help me win the race.
I want you to be healthy and full of life.
I want you to boost your charm.
I'm uneasy about this, so I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll do just that, then! Are you sure with
your
choice? There's no going back
after!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
All righty, just leave it to me! Look
forward to
tomorrow! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, when
<chrname> shows
up for
training...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's overflowing with so much power
she's
almost unrecognizable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We took a chance and it paid off! This is
a great
leap toward achieving our goal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her condition is absolutely deplorable...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should've known better than to test our
luck. I'm
not the one suffering, yet I'm
full of regret.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

Sheesh, don't be so stingy! It's just a
harmless
needle!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa

I didn't
know you had a visitor.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the tumultuous storm leaves as
suddenly
as it came. I turn my focus back
to my work and
try to forget what
happened just now.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Had a change of heart, did you? No
worries, it
happens!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:

want me
to activate for your lovely
trainee!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:

all day!

my work and try to forget what

now.
